summary: Tested guest_lock feature end-to-end (backend + frontend, desktop 1920 & mobile 390) and index.html meta changes. All 9 requested scenarios PASS. Backend: GET /api/site returns guest_lock field; PUT /api/admin/site {guest_lock: true/false} toggles correctly as admin. Frontend with lock ON: homepage renders, product-card click, deep links (/vendors), footer links, mobile bottom nav all open guest-gate-dialog instead of navigating. Deep link /vendors redirects to / and opens gate; after buyer login via gate (gate-login-email-input, gate-login-password-input, gate-login-captcha-input, gate-login-captcha-question, gate-login-submit-button) user is navigated to the originally clicked /product/<id>. gate-login-switch-link switches to register form (gate-register-name-input, gate-register-back-link) and back. Header 'Log in' and 'Sign up' still navigate to /login and /register with lock on and the full-page login-* form works. With lock OFF, logged-out visitors browse freely (regression: /vendors opens, product click navigates to product page). index.html: meta description no longer contains 'emergent.sh', og:title/og:description/twitter tags present. Only 'emergent.sh' references remain inside the posthog analytics script src (expected). guest_lock left OFF per instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: GuestGate.jsx: event blocker uses capture-phase on document for click/pointerdown/submit which is a good approach. 'data-guest-allow' escape hatch is correctly set on header-login/header-register. Safe.
GuestGate.jsx uses user === false as sentinel for 'logged out' (vs undefined while loading) — relies on AuthContext explicitly setting user=false; worth a code comment but functional.
AdminSite GuestLockEditor optimistically updates and rolls back on error — good UX.
context_for_next_testing_agent: guest_lock was set back to OFF at end of this run as requested. Feature works correctly across desktop/mobile. Reusable backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_guest_lock.py.
